---
title: "3) Daily series"
lang: en
---

**Daily** mean (`P1D`, the finest granularity of the API) of CH4 over Brazil.
The Statistical API aggregates on the server: you get the series ready, without
downloading images.

::: {.callout-note}
Pick a language in the **"Linguagem do código"** selector (top of the side index or
in the navbar). The choice applies to the **whole site** and is remembered across
pages.
:::

## Code

::: {.lang-python}
```python
import tropomi_ch4 as tch4
from tropomi_ch4 import plot

# One request per year (more robust to failures)
df = tch4.daily(start="2019-01-01", end=None)   # None = up to today
df.to_csv("serie_diaria_ch4_brasil.csv", index=False)

plot.plot_series(df, title="Daily mean CH4 over Brazil — TROPOMI",
                 outfile="serie_diaria_ch4_brasil.png")
```
:::

::: {.lang-r}
```r
source("r/tropomi_ch4.R")   # ch4_diaria(), ch4_mensal(), ch4_anual()

# One request per year (more robust to failures)
diaria <- ch4_diaria("2019-01-01")   # up to today
write.csv(diaria, "serie_diaria_ch4_brasil.csv", row.names = FALSE)

mensal <- aggregate(ch4_ppb ~ format(data, "%Y-%m"), data = diaria, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
plot(as.Date(paste0(mensal[[1]], "-01")), mensal$ch4_ppb, type = "l", col = "darkred",
     xlab = "Year", ylab = "CH4 (ppb)", main = "Daily CH4 over Brazil — TROPOMI")
```
:::

Columns:

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `data` | observation date |
| `ch4_ppb` | mean CH4 (ppb) over Brazil |
| `n_validos` | number of valid pixels |
| `ano`, `mes` | helpers |

## Under the hood

The call uses the **Statistical API** with the Brazil box, the period and an
**evalscript** that reads the `CH4` band (quality-filtered) and computes the mean.
The implementation lives in `tropomi_ch4/` (Python) and `r/tropomi_ch4.R` (R).

Notebook: [`notebooks/01_diaria.ipynb`](https://github.com/LudimiladeAzevedoBeltran/tropomi-ch4-brasil/blob/main/notebooks/01_diaria.ipynb).
